title: External JsdSolar SmartESS G-command family evidence
summary: External discussion of a JsdSolar/SmartESS device lists the same G-command family shape, including GPDAT0, GPV, GBAT, GMOD, GTMP, GCHG, GOP, GLINE, GBUS, GINV, GWS, Q1, and F. This supports treating the captured ValueCloud traffic as a distinct G-ASCII protocol family rather than as PI30 ASCII.
